affected_subject.reason: Identifies DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() and CLFactory.getSwapFee() as the affected components.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete condition: a dynamically calculated fee above 100,000 (10%) is rejected by CLFactory.getSwapFee().

direct_effect.reason: Fee above 10% is rejected and system falls back to default tick spacing fee, losing discounts and anti-MEV cap.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Conflicting caps (500,000 vs 100,000) establish expected-vs-actual numeric relation; mitigation states aligning thresholds.

summary: Report identifies affected fee functions, the trigger (fee above 10% rejected), the direct effect (fallback to default fee, lost discounts/anti-MEV), and a numeric cap-conflict basis for the safety relation.
